description: Listing generator + SKU generation + listing preview + batch listing + modular marketplace publisher (P0 item 11; P1 items 14,16; sections 17,18,19,20,22). For an individual card, generate a marketplace-ready listing (optimized title without keyword stuffing, description, condition, category, item specifics, price from the pricing engine, SKU, quantity, shipping) and show an eBay-style preview editable before publish. Batch listing: select many inventory items and generate that many draft listings, then approve individually / bulk approve / edit / reject / return to inventory. Automatic SKU generation with a configurable format (e.g. PKM-OBF-125-NM-001). Marketplace publishing is behind a MarketplacePublisher interface with a mock in-process publisher (marks Listed, assigns a fake external id) so a real eBay/TCGplayer API can drop in later without UI changes.
steps: Reminder: zero deps, `unset NODE_OPTIONS`. Depends on FEAT-001 (listings table, router), FEAT-002 (inventoryRepo, cardsRepo, tcg strategy formatCardTitle/skuGameCode, card_detail view), FEAT-003 (PricingEngine for price/fees/shipping/net). Read those before starting.

src/services/skuGenerator.ts: generateSku(input:{ gameCode, setAbbreviation, cardNumber, condition, sequence }): default format `${gameCode}-${setAbbrev}-${number}-${conditionCode}-${seq3}` (e.g. PKM-OBF-125-NM-001) using the tcg strategy skuGameCode + a condition->code map (Near Mint->NM etc.); sequence is a per-user monotonically increasing counter (derive from existing inventory/listing SKUs or a users counter). Allow a custom format string from Settings (tokens {game}{set}{number}{condition}{seq}). Ensure uniqueness per user; expose a way to assign a SKU to an inventory row that lacks one (section 21,22).

src/services/interfaces/listingGenerator.ts + src/services/listingGenerator.ts: ListingGenerator.generateForInventory(userId, inventoryId, opts?:{mode}): builds a Listing draft: title via tcg strategy (e.g. 'Charizard ex 125/197 Obsidian Flames Ultra Rare Pokemon TCG NM' - section 17 example, search-optimized, NO keyword stuffing), description (card details, condition, shipping note), condition, category, itemSpecifics (set, number, rarity, language, holo), price + shipping from PricingEngine (respect pricing mode), SKU from skuGenerator, quantity from inventory. Return a draft (not yet persisted or persisted with status 'draft').

src/services/interfaces/marketplace.ts + src/services/mock/mockMarketplacePublisher.ts: MarketplacePublisher.publish(listing): Promise<{ externalId, publishedAt }>; the mock assigns a deterministic fake external id and timestamp and does NOT hit any network (section 20,42 - never expose real credentials to the frontend; real eBay/TCGplayer/Whatnot/Mercari/Shopify impls plug in behind this interface). Document the abstraction. unpublish/return support to move a listing back to draft/inventory.

src/repositories/listingsRepo.ts: flesh out CRUD + search: create draft, update (title/desc/price/condition/shipping/specifics/status), getById(userId,id), listByUser(filters: status, marketplace, q), delete. Status lifecycle: draft -> ready -> listed (published) -> (ended/sold). Link inventory_id; when a listing goes 'listed', set inventory.status='Listed' and date_listed; when reverted, restore inventory status.

src/views/pages/listings.ts + route GET /listings: Listings management page - table/cards of listings with status badges (draft/ready/listed), marketplace, title, price, SKU; filters; actions to edit, publish (via mock publisher), end, delete, return to inventory. src/views/pages/listing_preview.ts + route GET /listings/:id: eBay-style listing PREVIEW (section 18) showing photos (placeholder), title, price, condition, description, shipping, item specifics, all editable before publishing; Save + Publish buttons.

Individual listing generation entry points: on Card Detail (FEAT-002) and Inventory rows, add 'Generate Listing' which calls the generator and opens the preview. Route POST /inventory/:id/listing (or /api/listings/generate) creates the draft and redirects to the preview.

Batch listing (section 19, P1 item 14): src/views/pages/listings_batch.ts + routes: from the Inventory page allow selecting multiple rows (checkboxes) -> 'Generate Listings' -> POST /api/listings/batch-generate {inventoryIds[]} creates that many drafts and shows a batch review screen where each draft can be approved individually, bulk-approved (publish all), edited (link to preview), rejected, or returned to inventory. Show counts and a bulk 'Approve all' / 'Publish all' control.

src/api/listings.ts: JSON endpoints: POST /api/listings/generate {inventoryId,mode}, POST /api/listings/batch-generate {inventoryIds[],mode}, PUT /api/listings/:id (edit fields), POST /api/listings/:id/publish, POST /api/listings/:id/return (back to inventory), DELETE /api/listings/:id, POST /api/listings/batch-approve {ids[]}. All session-user scoped, validated, with field-level errors; publishing goes through MarketplacePublisher.
Settings: add SKU format string + default marketplace + default pricing mode for generation to the Settings page (FEAT-003 settings service).

Tests (node:test): src/services/skuGenerator.test.ts - format PKM-OBF-125-NM-001, custom format tokens, per-user sequence increments + uniqueness. src/services/listingGenerator.test.ts - title matches the section-17 pattern and contains name/number/set/rarity/condition without duplicated keywords, price/shipping come from the pricing engine and respect mode, SKU assigned. src/services/listingsPublish.test.ts - generating a draft then publishing via the mock publisher sets listing status 'listed' + external id and flips the linked inventory to 'Listed'; batch-generate creates N drafts; return-to-inventory restores inventory status. Verify publishing is fully behind the MarketplacePublisher interface (swap-safe).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` and `npm test` pass including SKU, listing generator, and publish tests.

Generating a listing for a card produces a search-optimized title (section-17 format), description, condition, category, item specifics, price+shipping from the pricing engine, a generated SKU, and quantity; the eBay-style preview renders and is editable before publish.
SKUs are generated in the configurable format (default PKM-OBF-125-NM-001) with a unique per-user sequence.
Batch listing: selecting N inventory items generates N draft listings and the review screen supports approve individually / bulk approve / edit / reject / return to inventory.

Publishing goes through the MarketplacePublisher interface (mock marks Listed + assigns external id, no network, no exposed credentials) and updates the linked inventory status to Listed; returning a listing restores inventory status.
Marketplace publishing is swappable without UI changes (interface-driven), verified by a test using only the interface + mock.
